title: Settings — Assistant settings row wording, round 2

steps.headline: The Assistant settings row now reads "Models, permissions, defaults".
steps.changed: "and more" is gone, as you asked. Before, the line showed your default model, like "Claude Code · Sonnet".
steps.notice: In Meadow Mist the whole line fits. The model picker on the panel's General page still shows which model new chats use.
steps.risk: In Light, Dark, Midnight and Crème, whose font is wider, the line is still cut to "Models, permissions, defaul…", two letters short.
